ammonia.reason: no ripening proteolysis, low protein 9.65%, no amino acid deamination

animal_barnyard.reason: trace goat-derived p-cresol/indole diluted by cow milk and cream addition

bitter.reason: Maillard melanoidins and concentrated whey minerals offset by high sugar

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no methyl ketone blue pathway

browning.reason: hours evaporation Maillard of lactose with whey protein to melanoidins brown mass

buttery.reason: added cream 51g/100g retains milkfat diacetyl/acetoin from sweet whey starter

cheesy_sweaty.reason: low free butanoic acid 106 mg/kg with no rennet lipolysis or ripening

creaminess.reason: 29.51% fat homogenized whey-cream emulsion smooth in mouth despite low moisture

crumbliness.reason: evaporated kneaded lactose-crystallized mass with no rennet curd fracture

firmness.reason: 13.44% moisture ~86% solids lactose-crystallized plastic block sliceable thin

floral_honey.reason: Maillard phenylalanine Strecker phenylacetaldehyde plus lactose sweetness as honey

fruity.reason: no yeast/NSLAB fermentation, minimal ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification

goaty.reason: goat whey free C6:0 35mg/kg C8:0 31mg/kg C10:0 180mg/kg caprine fatty acids

malty_nutty.reason: prolonged boiling Maillard and Strecker aldehydes maltol furanones toasted-nut

melt.reason: denatured whey protein plus crystallized lactose, no intact casein network to flow

oil_off.reason: fat emulsified in concentrated lactose-protein matrix, little free oil release

smoky.reason: not smoked, only trace Maillard furans/guaiacol from browning

sour_vinegar.reason: sweet whey pH>5.6 evaporated, no lactic/acetic acid ripening

stretch.reason: no rennet para-casein network, no pasta-filata alignment

sulfur_cooked.reason: heat denaturation of beta-lactoglobulin releases H2S/DMS/methional cooked-milk

sweet.reason: 39% carbohydrate 38% sugar lactose plus added sucrose, most sugary cheese

umami.reason: concentrated whey glutamate/peptides but masked by caramel sweetness
